title: Broken handle on arrival TWICE!
text: Broken handle on arrival TWICE!. Twice Amazon sent this to me and twice the handle was broken. First time I cut my hand taking it out of the box the broken edge was so sharp. Second time the metal insert to the plastic handle was bent almost in half and plastic shattered. I dont' understand such garbage from such a good name.

product_metadata.title: Farberware 21582 Dishwasher Safe High Performance Nonstick Frying Pan with Glass Lid / Nonstick Deep Skillet, 12 Inch, Black
features: STOVE TO OVEN FRYING PAN: This versatile skillet is constructed from fast-heating aluminum, and is oven safe to 350°F. Go from the cooktop directly into the oven!
SHATTER-RESISTANT GLASS LID: The sturdy glass lid seals in heat and moisture while you watch foods cook, making it perfect for one-pot recipes for the whole family.
ENHANCED NONSTICK SKILLET: Features the SmartGlide Nonstick System of durable, top-quality nonstick with a dimpled surface to create air pockets that heat food quickly and evenly.
DISHWASHER SAFE: For fast and easy cleanup after cooking, this handy 12-inch frying pan with SmartGlide Nonstick is conveniently dishwasher safe.
description: The Farberware 21582 Dishwasher Safe High Performance Nonstick 12-Inch Frying Pan continues traditions while improving with new technology for today’s busy cooks. The frying pan is arguably the handiest tool in the kitchen, and with this 12-Inch aluminum skillet, larger recipes are completed with ease. This skillet features top-quality nonstick coating in the unique SmartGlide Nonstick System. The nonstick is shaped onto a dimpled fry pan surface, improving the nonstick’s durability and creating air pockets that transfer heat to food quickly. The result is a frying pan that warms evenly and food that is beautifully browned. The nonstick skillet is oven safe to 350°F and dishwasher safe for swift and simple cleanup. This Farberware 21582 Dishwasher Safe High Performance Nonstick 12-Inch Frying Pan is a versatile skillet that busy cooks will reach for morning, noon and night.
